name: gamecheck-progress
description: A pane that shows gamecheck test runs live: the scenario in flight, its step, the pass/fail count, and the failures.

progressFile.title: Progress file
progressFile.description: The file gamecheck writes live progress to (gamecheck run --progress writes .gamecheck/progress.json under the folder it runs in). A relative path is under the session's working folder.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when a run starts
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself when a new run appears in the progress file.
